nurture_ember.name: Nurture the Ember
nurture_ember.tooltip: Tend the central ember. The scattered ones stir in reply.

effects.log: You cup the ember in your hands. It answers with a flare. Scattered embers around you brighten. Shards of forgotten light pulse in the ash.

feed_ember.name: Feed the Ember
feed_ember.tooltip: Feed a shard to the central ember. The pulse strengthens; more embers glow.

effects.log: You feed the ember a shard. The pulse steadies. The dark retreats a step. Other embers glimmer in the ash.

gather_shards.name: Gather Shards
gather_shards.tooltip: Pull warm shards from the embers scattered in the ash. Fuel for the pulse.

raise_haven.name: Raise a Haven
raise_haven.tooltip: A place for more of the lost to stay near the ember. (each brings more, but the weight adds up)

set_foraging.name: Mark the Lines
set_foraging.tooltip: Send them along marked lines in the ash. They return with more.

demand_more.name: Demand More
demand_more.tooltip: Push them for more now. Gets results.
demand_more.unlock_log: A new thought occurs while watching the lost work the ash. It feels like the only natural next step.

effects.log: You reach deeper into them. 'Give more.' The ember brightens. Something in their eyes goes quiet. The ones who stayed at the first haven already knew this demand.

assign_forager.name: Send Forager
assign_forager.tooltip: Put a lost one to work the ash.

effects.log: Another pair of hands sent into the ash.

unassign_forager.name: Call Back Forager
unassign_forager.tooltip: Return them to the ember's light.

defend_paths.name: Defend the Paths
defend_paths.tooltip: Spend shards to watch the paths. Holds back ash threats for a while. (strength fades over time)
defend_paths.unlock_log: The paths are open. Defend what you have claimed.

effects.log: You set watchers on the paths. The lost who walk know eyes are on the ash with them.
